page=canvas(size=(180 mm,140 mm),background="#ffffff")
s=plot_style(font_family="/workspace/LayMesh/examples/assets/DejaVuSans.ttf")
p=plot(size=(100 mm,80 mm),plot_area=box(offset=(20 mm, 20 mm), size=(60 mm, 40 mm)),x=axis(range=(0,3),ticks=[]),y=axis(range=(0,2),ticks=[]),style=s)
p.hline(y=1,color="#ff0000",line_width=2 mm)
p.scatter(x=[1,2,2],y=[1,1,1],marker_size=10 mm,marker_fill="none",marker_border_color="#000000",marker_border_width=1 mm,opacity=0.5)
page.add(p)

page=canvas(size=(180 mm,140 mm),background="#ffffff")
s=plot_style(font_family="/workspace/LayMesh/examples/assets/DejaVuSans.ttf")
p=plot(size=(130 mm,100 mm),plot_area=box(offset=(20 mm, 20 mm), size=(80 mm, 60 mm)),style=s)
p.line(x=[0,1,2],y=[0,1,2],marker="diamond",marker_fill="none",marker_border_color="#111111",marker_border_width=0.2 mm,marker_size=3 mm,label="Same")
p.errorbar(x=[0,1,2],y=[1,2,3],xerr=0.1,yerr=0.2,marker="triangle_down",marker_fill="#ffffff",marker_border_color="#222222",marker_size=3 mm,label="Same")
p.scatter(x=[0,1,2],y=[2,3,4],marker="square",label="Square")
p.legend(position=(0 mm,-15 mm),columns=3)
page.add(p)

page=canvas(size=(180 mm,140 mm),background="#ffffff")
s=plot_style(font_family="/workspace/LayMesh/examples/assets/DejaVuSans.ttf")
p=plot(size=(150 mm,90 mm),plot_area=box(offset=(20 mm, 20 mm), size=(110 mm, 50 mm)),x=axis(range=(0,5),ticks=[]),y=axis(range=(0,2),ticks=[]),style=s)
p.scatter(x=[1],y=[1],marker="square",marker_size=10 mm,marker_fill="none",marker_border_color="#000000",marker_border_width=1 mm)
p.scatter(x=[2],y=[1],marker="diamond",marker_size=10 mm,marker_fill="none",marker_border_color="#000000",marker_border_width=1 mm)
p.scatter(x=[3],y=[1],marker="triangle",marker_size=10 mm,marker_fill="none",marker_border_color="#000000",marker_border_width=1 mm)
p.scatter(x=[4],y=[1],marker="triangle_down",marker_size=10 mm,marker_fill="none",marker_border_color="#000000",marker_border_width=1 mm)
p.errorbar(x=[1],y=[0.2],xerr=0.2,label="Horizontal")
p.errorbar(x=[4],y=[0.2],yerr=0.1,label="Vertical")
p.legend(position=(0 mm,-15 mm),columns=2)
page.add(p)

page=canvas(size=(180 mm,140 mm),background="#ffffff")

page=canvas(size=(180 mm,140 mm),background="#ffffff")
s=plot_style(font_family="/workspace/LayMesh/examples/assets/DejaVuSans.ttf")
import { title } from "./part/label.lay"
label=title()
p=plot(size=(140 mm,110 mm),plot_area=box(offset=(30 mm, 20 mm), size=(70 mm, 55 mm)),x=axis(label=label),y=axis(label=formula(source=r"\beta^2",font_size=9 pt)),style=s)
h=p.heatmap(z=[[0,1],[2,3]])
p.line(x=[0,1],y=[0,1],label=label)
p.legend(position=(0 mm,-16 mm),font_size=5 pt)
p.colorbar(h,label=label)
page.add(p)
page.add(p,size=(160 mm, 125 mm))

page=canvas(size=(180 mm,140 mm),background="#ffffff")
